question: Find the square root of 0.000324.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

0.000324 = 324 × 10−⁶

√324 = 18

√10−⁶ = 10−³

⇒ √0.000324 = 18 × 10−³

⇒ = 0.018

**∴ The correct answer is 0.018 value.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number = 0.000324

**Formula Used:**

√(a × b) = √a × √b

**Calculations:**

⇒ 0.000324 = 324 × 10−⁶

⇒ √0.000324 = √324 × √10−⁶

⇒ = 18 × 10−³

⇒ = 18 × 0.001

⇒ = 0.018

**∴ The correct answer is 0.018 value.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Decimal Square Root Trick

Count decimal places in pairs from right to left. The square root will have half as many decimal places.

Perfect Square

324 = 18², therefore √324 = 18.

Scientific Notation Method

Writing decimals as powers of 10 makes square root calculations faster.
